Given the failure to pass meconium and bilious vomiting in a newborn, I need to rule out Hirschsprung's disease. The X-ray showing dilated bowel loops and the history of bilious vomiting with failure to pass meconium strongly indicate a distal obstruction, most likely intestinal atresia or Hirschsprung disease. Since we have exhausted our questioning on history, I must proceed to a definitive diagnosis based on these findings.
